summary: Patched the programmatic flashlight Rerun stream so regular inspection images are logged under top-level images/* paths, final-tone-curve RGB is logged as opaque 3-channel RGB for both 2D and projected camera views, and depth remains outside spear/camera.
work_completed: Moved 2D image paths to images/rgb, images/depth_meters, images/depth_meters_visualization, images/world_normal_visualization, and images/diffuse_color_visualization.

Kept spatial paths under spear: camera pose/frustum at spear/camera, RGB projection at spear/camera/rgb_projection, camera position at spear/camera_position, trajectory at spear/camera_trajectory, and light direction/status under spear/light/.
Changed final_tone_curve_hdr conversion to drop alpha and emit opaque RGB, avoiding zero/invalid alpha making the projected image black or transparent.
Added a top-level 2D depth visualization image in addition to the top-level rr.DepthImage depth stream.
Updated README and running guide with corrected Rerun path hierarchy.

findings.message: Static check found no spear/images paths and no depth image logged under spear/camera. The only rr.DepthImage log is images/depth_meters.
Live simulator/Rerun validation was not run because the task explicitly prohibited simulator-dependent commands.

follow_up_recommendations: Run the live Rerun stream with a simulator and viewer to visually confirm the corrected hierarchy and RGB projection.
